messages:
olga: Quick design review of the Keys page & rotate/revoke flows. Goal: final copy + a11y pass. Posting screenshots in thread.

maya: Thanks. Overall layout feels cleaner. A few items: empty state when no keys exist, placement of 'Create key' (left vs right), and the rotate microcopy.

sam: Accessibility first: empty state CTA must have descriptive aria-label (e.g., 'Create API key, opens modal'). Also color contrast for the orange warning pill is low on the mock. Need >=4.5:1 for body copy.

jeremy: On Create modal: prefer TTL dropdown (1h, 24h, 7d, 30d, No expiry) instead of inline radios. Avoid the term 'permanent'; use 'No expiry (for service accounts only)'.

olga: Agree on TTL wording. For empty state copy: suggest short hero copy: 'No API keys yet' then a one-liner: 'Create keys for services and CI. Keys are shown once after creation.' Keep CTA: 'Create API key' (primary).

aisha: Key reveal/accessibility: show masked placeholder and a 'Show' button. When shown, fire aria-live: 'API key revealed: copy now. This value will not be shown again.' After copy, announce 'Copied to clipboard.' Focus should move to the copy button after reveal.

maya: Revoke flow: three options were proposed. We prefer a single-step modal with a short typed confirmation for high-risk keys. For lower-risk (project-scoped) allow checkbox. Make this org-configurable.

jeremy: I propose default text 'Type REVOKE to confirm' for orgs with 'high risk' setting. Make the input autosubmit when text matches and Enter pressed. Add visible helper text: 'Action will be logged in org audit logs.'

olga: Rotation UX: include a small 'Notify teammates' toggle (off by default) that builds a templated message and includes copyable rotation scripts for bash, node, and common CI platforms. Keep the toggle close to the 'Rotate' CTA.

sam: Example rotation snippet for templated copy (put into the template region):
```bash
# rotate key: OLD_KEY -> NEW_KEY
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/rotate" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer OLD_KEY" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"notify":true,"project":"frontend"}'
```
Include a small accessibility note: ensure the code block is keyboard-focusable and has an accessible 'Copy' button with aria-label.

maya: Copy nits: change 'Revoke immediately' CTA to 'Revoke now — this cannot be undone.' Use sentence case and short verbs for all CTAs. Also 'Rotate key' vs 'Create rotated key' should be 'Rotate key'.

ajery: (typo correction) I meant jeremy: We'll spec color tokens for danger and warning and add contrast checks to QA checklist.

olga: Permission controls: org owners see granular scope chips (embeddings, generate, admin); project editors see a simplified 'Project-scoped' toggle. When scopes are selected, show an 'Effective permissions' inline summary that translates chips to plain English.

aisha: Keyboard flow: Tab order must go: close -> name input -> scope -> TTL -> restrictions -> Create. If 'Show key' is used in modal, keyboard focus should land on copy button next. Provide focus-visible styles that pass high-contrast. Live region announcements required when key is revealed or when revoke/rotate completes.

maya: Audit link placement: put 'Will be logged to org audit trail' under the primary CTA as low-emphasis text linking to audit settings. That was consensus from legal and security.

product-bot: Updated Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/efgh567/keys-page-v3?node-id=88:12 (edited 30m ago) :spiral_calendar_pad:

olga: For empty-state helpful copy, add a short inline example command to create a key with CLI: `redwood keys create --name "ci-web" --ttl 30d` so engineers can get started. Make sure the code snippet has proper contrast and accessible copy button.

sam: QA checklist items I'll add: contrast for warning/danger tokens, focus-visible for interactive controls, aria-live tests for reveal/revoke/rotate, keyboard-only path for all modals, and screen reader verification of effective permissions summary.

maya: Action items: maya - iterate copy in Figma + update empty state; jeremy - spec color tokens and add tests; sam - create rotation code snippets and ensure copy accessible; olga - craft notification templates; aisha - write live region strings and keyboard flow notes.

maya: I'll push the next mock by EOD and schedule a follow-up sync tomorrow 11am. :thumbsup:
